_about: Scout drone (upgrade paths plan §6.2, 2026-11-15): flight rules shared by every level. What changes with the level (speed_mps, vertical_mps, flight_seconds, flights_per_sol, survey_radius_m, ability) is read from data/area_levels.json (track scout_drone) first; level_defaults below is the fallback with the same numbers (index = level - 1). The radio range is the command track's (command.drone_range_m). The flight feel copies the owner's FPV example (docs/revisions/reference/fpv_drone/flight_controller.gd): the five *_response numbers and the two pitch angles are taken from it unchanged. Everything else is DESIGNER BALANCE chosen for pacing and fun for ages 9-12, unless a _notes entry says it comes from NASA's Ingenuity Mars helicopter. Positions are Godot metres, times are real seconds.

_notes.level_defaults.speed_mps: designer balance (game-scale map ~560 x 530 m). Ingenuity's real top speed was about 10 m/s; the drone is kept slower so the map stays big.
_notes.level_defaults.flight_seconds: designer balance, shortened from Ingenuity's real flights of about 90-169 s so a flight fits a play session.
_notes.level_defaults.flights_per_sol: designer balance. Ingenuity flew at most once every few sols, recharging from its solar panel in between; the game allows 1-4 flights per sol.
_notes.level_defaults.survey_radius_m: designer balance: how far around the point under the drone its cameras / spectrometer / radar reveal ore (V2+).
_notes.level_defaults.ability: owner's design (plan §6.2): V1 manual, V2 pre-scout + revisit explored spots, V3 find a known ore, V4 scan anywhere. Sensor names follow real Mars instruments (CRISM-style multispectral, neutron/gamma spectrometer, RIMFAX-style ground radar); no number is taken from them.
_notes.*_response, *_pitch_deg: from the owner's FPV example (flight_controller.gd), not from Ingenuity.
_notes.charge_factor: designer balance: charging on the pad takes twice the flying time it puts back (empty to full = 2 x flight_seconds). The idea of charging between every flight follows Ingenuity, which recharged its batteries from its solar panel between flights; the factor itself is not an Ingenuity number.
_notes.home_margin, home_reserve_s: designer balance: the drone turns home by itself when its battery holds only the trip home x 1.1 plus 3 s.
_notes.max_altitude_m: designer balance. Ingenuity's highest flights reached about 24 m.
_notes.cruise_altitude_m: designer balance: the autopilot flies 10 m above the ground.
_notes.empty_return_speed_factor: designer balance: should the battery ever run empty, it limps home at half speed.
_notes.range_warn_fraction: designer balance: a warning at 90 % of the command room's radio range; the drone stops at the edge.
_notes.spot_hover_s, target_hover_s: designer balance: the autopilot hovers 4 s over each spot or deposit to scan it.
_notes.search_legs, search_offset_m: designer balance: the V4 search pattern zig-zags twice, up to 14 m to each side, on the way to the target area.
_notes.spot_min_m, spot_merge_m, max_spots: designer balance: an explored spot is remembered when at least 15 m from the pad; spots closer than 10 m merge; the newest 12 are kept.
